description: The chart illustrates the percentage point difference across various layers of two models, XLM-R and another unnamed model, with the primary purpose of comparing their performance. The horizontal axis represents the layer numbers, ranging from 0 to 12, and an additional category labeled "concat", while the vertical axis is labeled "% point difference" with a linear scale ranging from -10 to 0, marked at intervals of 2. The XLM-R model is represented by light blue bars in the top chart, and the other model is represented by dark blue bars in the bottom chart, with both charts sharing the same x-axis but having identical y-axes. For the XLM-R model, the bars decrease in length from left to right, with the longest bar at layer 1 having a value of approximately -8.5, and the shortest bar at layer 9 having a value close to 0; the "concat" bar has a value of around -1. For the other model, the bars also generally decrease in length from left to right, with the longest bar at layer 1 having a value of around -8, and the shortest bars from layer 9 onwards having values close to 0; the "concat" bar has a value of approximately -0.5. Both charts have their bars sorted in ascending order by layer number, and no bars are visually emphasized.
